evidence_quotes:
(All models except M1123 and “A2”
vehicles). Check all drivebelts tension
using belt tension gauge. Belt tension
should be 70 lbs (311 N) minimum. If
belt tension is not at least 70 lbs (311 N),
adjust drivebelts (paragraph 3-82). Tension
should not be greater than 110 lbs (489 N)
for new belts; old belts 95 lbs (422 N).
statements.reason: The drivebelt procedure gives these limits for all models except M1123 and A2 vehicles.
statements.statement: For a vehicle other than M1123 or A2, the specified tension for a new accessory drivebelt is at least 70 lbs (311 N) and not greater than 110 lbs (489 N).

statements.statement: For a vehicle other than M1123 or A2, the tightening torque for alternator mounting bolts is not specified in the provided excerpts.
